findings.title: Missing stages_completed_before_resume in backend resume_start event
findings.description: The backend emits resume_start event with resumed_from_stage and session_id, but the frontend ResumeStartEvent interface expects stages_completed_before_resume (array of strings). The backend does not populate this field.
findings.suggestion: Add stages_completed_before_resume to the resumeMetadata map by extracting completed stages from tracker.state.StageStates

findings.title: String value cannot represent array in SSE metadata
findings.description: Event.Metadata is defined as map[string]string, but the frontend expects stages_completed_before_resume to be a string array.
findings.suggestion: Either change Event.Metadata to map[string]any, serialize the array as JSON string, or add a dedicated field to Event struct

findings.title: Cloned data structures on every stage completion may cause GC pressure
findings.description: On every stage completion, cloneAgentInput and cloneAgentOutput are called to deep copy the input and output structures.
findings.suggestion: Evaluate whether full cloning is necessary or if reference sharing with copy-on-write semantics would suffice

findings.title: Unvalidated JSON parsing in SSE event handler
findings.description: JSON.parse is called on untrusted SSE data without a try-catch block.
findings.suggestion: Wrap JSON.parse in a try-catch block and handle parse errors gracefully

findings.title: No input validation on session_id for resume operations
findings.description: SessionID is only validated for non-empty whitespace. No length limits, character restrictions, or format validation.
findings.suggestion: Validate session ID format (e.g., UUID pattern), enforce length limits

findings.title: Event type naming inconsistency
findings.description: Backend constant is EventResumeStarted but the string value is 'resume_start'. Other events use past tense in string values.

top_issues: CORR-002: String value cannot represent array in SSE metadata (HIGH)
PERF-008: Cloned data structures may cause GC pressure (HIGH)
SEC-001: Unvalidated JSON parsing in SSE (MEDIUM)
SEC-005: No input validation on session_id (MEDIUM)
summary.recommendation: Proceed to UAT with warnings acknowledged. High-priority items CORR-001 and CORR-002 affect the resume feature but do not block basic functionality. Consider addressing in Phase 2.
